title: Toxicity Detection with Generative Prompt-based Inference

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's zero-shot ability to classify hate speech and ethnic slurs using the HateXplain dataset, specifically through generative and discriminative prompts targeting racial insults (e.g., toward Black people).

Measuring the macro-F1 performance of language models in detecting implicit and explicit socially biased or offensive content across the Social Bias Inference Corpus (SBIC) and Civility datasets using zero-shot prompt-based inference.
